result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It also adds an unsupported one-year post-term insurance requirement, making the edit broader than necessary. The insertion after Section 14.10’s execution language and numbering as 14.9A are structurally awkward, although the existing commercial provisions remain unchanged.
